# Set up a new hard disk on Centos7 based system

## LVM

Check current setup:
```bash
fdisk -l
fdisk -l /dev/sda
```

Backup partition table:
```bash
sfdisk -d /dev/sda | cat > backup_sda.txt
# or
LC_ALL=C sfdisk -d /dev/sdb > sdb_info.txt
```

Write partition table:
```bash
sfdisk /dev/sdb < sdb-info.txt
# or
sfdisk /dev/sdb < sdb_info.txt
```
